cves.title: RCE via out-of-memory corruption
cves.description: Out-of-memory handling can interrupt PHP while internal request data is only partially initialized; request cleanup may then treat invalid data as valid, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution. Highest risk under mod_php.

cves.title: RCE via stale global state
cves.description: Request-owned internal state can survive after its backing memory is freed; a later request on the same worker may use that stale state before initialization resets it, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution.

note: Partial mitigations do not make an installation safe. Updating to the patched version is the only complete fix.
